One cake is green and topped with green grapes and kiwi slices, while the other is beige, adorned with strawberries, whipped cream, and cookie pieces. A man's arm in a black long-sleeved shirt moves near the cakes. The background features wooden stairs, a yellow bag with a blue character, and bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene shifts to the child being held by an adult woman with dark hair pulled back. The girl is wearing a yellow t-shirt with a red octopus graphic and light grey leggings. She waves her right arm excitedly and mimics a "check it out" gesture with her hands. The background includes a neutral-toned sofa, a window with horizontal blinds, and a colorful play tent. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the green fruit cake on the counter as the child and woman remain in the background. The girl looks down at the food with a curious expression while the woman talks. (4) The video ends with a centered graphic on a solid pink background showing a cartoon illustration of a young girl sitting and holding a snack, with static white text appearing below her.
